decided_by: agent (per task R3 of the lead, epic #880 WP4, 2026-11-10)
rationale: AD-346, opt-in store path. Four modules join the contracts: archkeel.ir.store_seam (facts, public StoreSeam and active_store, because the dependency and member inventory digests ask the store), archkeel.ir.readset_codec (facts-codec), archkeel.ir.codec_store (wire) and archkeel.analyzer.store (process). The analyzer may use decode_read_set, StoreEntry, open_store, close_store and store_enabled; ir publishes them and store_disabled, which check uses to observe without the store. calls_unresolved rises from 970 to 979: the store process frames and the two context variables of the session (the active store and store_disabled) are dynamic receivers (store.py, store_seam.py). The two allowed type ignores of process.is_process_alive move 15 lines with the new store field. No rule, component or Any permission changes.
